podcast.body: This very old traditional Irish song was recorded by Thin Lizzy in 1972. Its lyrics can be traced back to an Irish criminal who was executed in 1650. The song has been covered numerous times both before and after Thin Lizzy's rendition, including a well-known cover by Metallica in 1996. "And then in 1972, they recorded a very old traditional Irish song called Whiskey in the Jar, the lyrics of which can be traced to an Irish criminal who was executed in 1650. It's been covered many, many times before and after Thin Lizzy. And yes, this is the same song, covered by Metallica in 1996."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
